businessModel: Free software from Fenrir Inc., a Japanese software and design company; no paid tier or ads listed on the official page
updateCadence: Windows: 6.5.12 Jul 2025, 6.5.13 Oct 2025, 6.5.14 Dec 2025, 6.5.15 Mar 2026, 6.5.16 Sept 2026; each mainly a Blink update
summary: Sleipnir is a Japanese freeware browser from Fenrir Inc., using the Blink engine on Windows with thumbnail tabs, right-drag mouse gestures and Fenrir Pass bookmark sync. Updates are infrequent and the Mac version is currently paused.
bestFor: Windows users who want mouse-gesture and thumbnail-tab navigation
Japanese-language users who like Fenrir's design and font rendering
People who want Chrome extensions in a lighter alternative shell
notFor: Anyone who needs timely Chromium security patches
Users who want built-in privacy tools or modern AI features
Mac users right now, since the release is paused
People who need an open-source browser

pros.title: Thumbnail tabs and gestures
pros.detail: Tabs show page thumbnails, right-button drag gestures close and restore tabs, and Thumb-roll flips through many tabs.

pros.title: Blink with Chrome extensions
pros.detail: The Windows build uses Blink (Chrome/152 in 6.5.16) and supports Chrome extensions.

pros.title: Tab groups and favorite tabs
pros.detail: Related tabs group together and frequently used pages stay open as persistent favorite tabs.

pros.title: Free sync and import
pros.detail: Fenrir Pass syncs bookmarks and the browser imports from older Sleipnir versions and other major browsers.

pros.title: Mobile versions
pros.detail: Sleipnir Mobile on Android reached 3.9.0 in Oct 2026 and the iOS app is at 5.1.1 per Wikipedia.

cons.title: Slow security cadence
cons.detail: There was no Windows release between 6.5.15 (Mar 24, 2026) and 6.5.16 (Sept 3, 2026), so Chromium fixes lag for months.

cons.title: Mac release paused
cons.detail: Fenrir paused the Mac release after finding a problem on macOS Tahoe 26, and Mac has no extension support.

cons.title: Thin privacy tooling
cons.detail: No tracker blocking, fingerprint protection or telemetry details are documented for the desktop browser.

cons.title: Closed and Japan-centric
cons.detail: Proprietary freeware with a Japanese-first site and limited English documentation.

faq.a: Yes. Sleipnir 6.5.16 for Windows shipped Sept 3, 2026 with Blink updated to Chrome/152, and Sleipnir Mobile for Android reached 3.9.0 in Oct 2026.
Fenrir says Sleipnir 6 uses Blink, and Chrome extension support is listed for Windows only.
A Mac version exists (macOS 10.13 or later), but Fenrir has paused the Mac release because of a macOS Tahoe 26 issue.

timeline.event: Sleipnir Mobile for Android first released (Sept 15)
Sleipnir 5 switches to the Blink engine (Dec 24)

switching.note: Imports from older Sleipnir versions and other major browsers; Sleipnir 6 installs alongside Sleipnir 4 and 5.
